name: Ballpit-TS-TW
title: Ballpit
blurb: Physics-based bouncing balls in WebGL that react to cursor movement.
description: Renders physics-simulated spheres using Three.js. Balls bounce off viewport edges and interact with cursor when followCursor=true. Built on raw WebGL with GSAP for event handling.
use_when: Interactive backgrounds, eye-catching hero sections, playful motion demos.
avoid_when: Mobile devices or older browsers; high CPU/GPU load. No touch support.
a11y: Pure decorative animation with no interactive purpose. Canvas has no aria attributes.
